results.fact: Total route distance

The itinerary's ~11 mi is the full round trip to the summit (3.6 mi of trail plus ~1.7 mi off-trail each way), so the two figures measure different things and agree.

results.fact: Season window (Nov-Jun) vs. an explicitly 'optimal' July-August climbing window
results.evidence: Sources confirm the peak is climbed both as a winter/early-spring snow scramble (Mountaineers winter-scramble listing; February 2025 trip reports) and as a summer alpine scramble (Mountaineers alpine-scramble trip report). So 'Nov-Jun' is too narrow. Meanwhile the row's pro_tips/best_season (winter preferred) and seasonal_guidance (Jul-Sep optimal) disagree about which window is best. Which window is 'optimal' is a preference, not a fact that two sources settle, so this needs an editorial decision (e.g. a year-round season with one agreed preferred window).
